tools.name: uae_corporate_tax
tools.description: Computes UAE Corporate Tax payable for one Tax Period under Federal Decree-Law 47 of 2022 from the caller's own figures, and returns the computation line by line with the Article behind each line. Use it when someone asks: how much corporate tax will my Dubai or UAE company pay, what is the UAE corp

tools.name: eu_ai_act_classify
tools.description: Classifies an AI system under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 from the caller's description of it and returns the risk class, the obligation set with article numbers, the date the obligations apply, and the maximum fine. Covers prohibited practices under Article 5, high-risk under Article 6 and Annex III,

tools.name: cbam_cost
tools.description: Computes the CBAM certificate cost of importing goods into the EU under Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2025/2083, for any year of the 2026 to 2034 phase-in, with the free-allocation phase-out factor from Directive (EU) 2023/959 Article 10a(1a). Handles all six Annex I sectors

tools.name: csrd_scope
tools.description: Returns the CSRD verdict per financial year under Directive (EU) 2022/2464 as amended by the Stop-the-clock Directive (EU) 2025/794 and Omnibus I Directive (EU) 2026/470, with the size test and the third-country test shown separately. Use it when someone asks: does CSRD apply to my company, do we ha

tools.name: compliance_deadlines
tools.description: Returns the statutory dates for a regime with the Article behind each one, and for UAE Corporate Tax computes the actual due date from the financial year end. Use it when someone asks: when is my UAE corporate tax return due, what is the deadline for a financial year ending 31 March or 31 December,

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "uae_corporate_tax" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Use it when someone asks: how much corporate tax will my Dubai or UAE company pay, what is the UAE corp"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
